name: HH regime-switch 03 — VIX-extreme contrarian long, ATR-sized stop into the panic (daily)
rationale: MECHANISM (distinct from 01/02: it gauges the crypto dislocation via range_position — where price sits inside its recent high/low band — instead of trailing return or realized vol, and it sizes the protective stop off ATR so the stop widens with the panic's own volatility rather than a fixed fraction that gets whipsawed out at the exact forced-seller bottom): the VIX extreme is the forced-deleveraging trigger; requiring range_position near the low of its band confirms price is pinned at the bottom of its range (the washed-out state a squeeze rebounds from), not mid-range. An ATR-multiple stop is the honest way to hold through the wide bars a panic produces — a fixed 8% stop is inside a single panic candle and guarantees a stop-out at the bottom. DISCONFIRMER: on vix_level>40 AND low-range entries (min 25 events), forward net-of-fee return must be >0; if the ATR stop does not reduce the rate of being stopped out at the local low versus a fixed stop (i.e. the fixed-stop version has a strictly better net-of-fee Sharpe), the ATR machinery adds nothing here. Kill if pre-2023 events carry the whole edge.
catalyst: VIX extreme with price pinned at the bottom of its range — a washed-out squeeze setup
